description: This file defines the SlidingTabLayout class, a custom UI component for Android that provides a scrollable tab indicator linked with a ViewPager, enabling users to view and switch between different pages with visual feedback.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom scrollable tab indicator component for ViewPager, enabling tab-based navigation with customizable appearance.

classes.name: SLidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface for customizing tab indicator and divider colors dynamically based on position.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Associates a ViewPager with this tab layout and populates tabs accordingly.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Sets a custom layout resource for tab views along with the TextView ID within that layout.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Configures the colors of the indicator for selected tabs.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Configures the colors of the dividers between tabs.

methods.name: setOnPageChangeListener
methods.description: Allows setting a listener to respond to page change events.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView styled as a tab, used when no custom layout is provided.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Populates the tab strip with views representing each page in the ViewPager.
